description: Read-only views of the brain by id or name; to search by content use crbro_recall. Nothing is written by any view: every read leaves the brain untouched. view=status answers any question about CRBRO itself: version, brain path, totals, last boot/consolidation, whether semantic recall is installed and on, hot_topics_recalculated. view=neuron: an index of one neuron — header, counts, connections (min_strength filters) and every entry as id, kind, date and preview, paged with limit/offset; entries=[ids or exact text] reads those in full, detail=full returns the whole neuron, shortened and declared when large. view=neurons: rows hottest first (id, name, domain, type, heat, last_accessed, facts_count), filtered by domain, type, min_heat, paged with limit/offset. view=sessions: day logs newest first, the only place session summaries are read. view=global_map: one cluster per domain plus cross-domain bridges, computed live. Params of other views are ignored.

detail.description: view=neuron: "index" (default) returns the header, counts and every entry as id, kind, date and a short preview — cheap, then read what matters with `entries`. "full" returns the whole neuron with facts paged by limit/offset; large neurons are shortened and say so.

entries.description: view=neuron: read these entries in full — their ids from the index or from crbro_recall, or their exact text. Any kind: fact, decision, pattern, preference, error, debt, or "map" for the system map. Ignores detail.

include_superseded.description: view=neuron: also list superseded and retracted entries of every kind (default false; the index reports how many are hidden in entries_pagination.hidden_retired). detail=full always returns entry_status.

limit.description: Page size. view=neuron: index entries per page (default 25, max 200); view=neurons: rows (default 50, max 500); view=sessions: day logs (default 10, max 100). Other views ignore it.

min_heat.description: view=neurons: minimum heat, 0.0-1.0. Heat blends access frequency, recency and connectivity.

min_strength.description: view=neuron: drop connections weaker than this (0.0-1.0). Omit or 0 = all.

neuron.description: view=neuron only, required there: neuron id (e.g. "project_octochat") or name (e.g. "OctoChat").

offset.description: Items to skip. view=neuron: index entries; view=neurons: rows after the heat sort. Default 0.

session.description: view=sessions: read one day log whole by its id, e.g. "session_2026-09-07" (from crbro_recall sessions_matched or the list). Ignores limit and offset.

view.description: Which read to perform. Only the params listed for that view are honoured; the rest are ignored, never an error.

name: crbro_inspect
title: Inspect the brain
